lines.ruling: Ruling: model error and scope; inherited from the candidate's lines 6 and 9. i1040gi p. 88, Line 1, TIP: "None of your refund is taxable if, in the year you paid the tax, you either (a) didn’t itemize deductions, or (b) elected to deduct state and local general sales taxes instead of state and local income taxes". The candidate's own choice (zero without a refund, zero when the 2024 tax was not deducted on Schedule A, line 9 otherwise) is the project's choice on refund.worksheet, with the box 8 and other-year gates (refund.not_2024, whose PENDING-5 wording adds tax paid "before 2024") met on every refund on both sides. On refund returns the differences are: stage16.mut.refund_single_unasked (single 2024 status; project $1,400.00, candidate unknown for refund.spouse_born) and stage16.mut.refund_line3_stop (line 3 STOP; project $0.00, candidate unknown for refund.status), inherited from lines 6 and 9 (model error there); and stage16.refuse.refund.line5e_bad (project refuses at the cited impossible-entry screen refund.line5e_bad, candidate $3,000.00): scope. The completed-return project-unknown (partials withholding refund.not_2024 or refund.itemized) are on bases with no refund: Every partial base of the bank is a return with no refund (refund.received $0.00), and s1.line1 reads the worksheet only when refund.has (refund.received more than zero) is true (forms/2025/s1.yaml), so the partial-record differences on those bases are on lines the return never reads. Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 90, worksheet line 6: "Multiply the number of boxes checked by $1,550 ($1,950 if your 2024 filing status was single or head of household)" and its footnote "*If your filing status is married filing separately, you can check the boxes for your spouse only if your spouse had no income, isn’t filing a return, and can’t be claimed as a dependent on another person’s return"; p. 33, Line 12d: "Don’t check any boxes for your spouse if your filing status is head of household". The candidate takes the spouse boxes for every 2024 filing status; the project counts them only for married filing jointly or separately, and zeroes them for single, head of household and qualifying surviving spouse (amb.2025.refund_boxes_2024). The candidate therefore needs the spouse answers where the source does not: stage16.mut.refund_single_unasked (single, a refund, the spouse questions unasked) gives the project $0.00 and the candidate unknown for refund.spouse_born.
